---
title: "Wildlife engagement paper published in Communications Sustainability"
date: 2026-02-05
description: "A large-scale study of wildlife content on YouTube examines what attracts attention and what drives meaningful conservation engagement."
categories: [Publication, Conservation, Social media]
---

Our study **“YouTube content on wildlife engages audiences but rarely drives meaningful conservation action”** is published in *Communications Sustainability*. The research examines how wildlife content attracts public attention and the extent to which online engagement translates into conservation-oriented responses.
